rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The site reports that Yeltsin announced his resignation as head of state and placed the exercise of presidential duties on Chairman of the Government Vladimir Putin; he made the statement in a television address shortly after noon, after a meeting with Putin in the Kremlin, and handed Putin the decree on relinquishing his powers in the presence of Patriarch Alexy II.
